Name: SocialNetwork
Author: Cecidelus
Description:
With this mod, your relationship with NPCs affects their related as if they talk to each other, making the social aspect of the game feels more alive.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
Every time you reach a new heart with a NPC, you will gain bonus friendship points with their friends and family! But if you lose a heart, you will lose points.

Imagine you want to be Abiail's friend, each time you reach a new heart level with her you will gain friendship points with Pierre, Caroline, Sam and Sebastian!! But if you hate Pam and insist giving her squids, Penny and Gus will get mad at you!

Every character has their own Network, made based on the [url=http://stardewcommunitywiki.com]Stardew Valley Wiki[/url] info about character family and friends, with some adjustments based on characters that spend time together (Like Penny with Jas and Vincent).

In the config.json you can change the following :
[list]
[*][b]Bonus[/b]: Amount of friendship points you gain/lose (Default: 50)
[*][b]TrackNetwork[/b]: Whether to show a message (like tool upgrade ready on morning) of the affected characters. (Default: true)
[*][b]"Network"[/b]: All characters and who is affected when you gain/lose heart with them. (Exemple: "Alex": [ "Evelyn", "George", "Haley" ])
[/list]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5
[*]Works in single player
[*]Should work in multiplayer
[/list]
